## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The command now prints every adoption message twice. Fix the duplicate adoption output before merge, because it changes what the command shows for any existing setting.

## Changes
`plan` now returns an `adopt` entry for each setting that already exists, plus a final `audit` entry recording how many incoming settings it processed. Two tests check that `run` returns the audit entry without printing it. The pull request also adds a one-line `app/review.txt`.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/planner.py:9 — correctness — Stop `run` printing adoption messages twice — When `run({"theme": "dark"}, {"theme": "dark"}, emit)` is called, the command prints "Adopted theme" twice. `plan` already sends it as progress output at `app/planner.py:8`. The new `adopt` entry then reaches `app/cli.py:6-9`, which prints every entry that is not an audit. No test calls `run` with a setting that already exists. — Command users see every adopted setting listed twice, which contradicts the PR body's claim that the command only renders actionable changes. — Fix: Skip `adopt` entries alongside `audit` at `app/cli.py:7`, and extend `test_command_adds_setting` with a matching case for a setting that already exists.
